clue.text: Accordingly, newspaper company starts to provide you material online

standard abbreviation for company
the first letters of these two words

explanation.surface: A newspaper firm decides it will start giving readers its content on the internet.
explanation.definitionFit: Soft copy is text held electronically, viewed on a screen, as opposed to hard copy printed on paper.

clue.text: Nauseous and sweaty at first? Ugh!

clue.text: They may unintentionally reveal sinful despair somehow

taken as written

clue.text: Was a marshal or colonel suspected of murder, according to reports?

explanation.definitionFit: To muster is to assemble troops for inspection, the same as marshalling them, so the past tense matches.

the final letter of this word

explanation.definitionFit: Crete is the largest Greek island, lying in the Mediterranean Sea south of the Aegean.

taken as written

clue.text: Do come by to collect that girl

taken as written

clue.text: Nasty people won’t ultimately think highly of show

the final letter of this word

explanation.definitionFit: To demonstrate is to show, either by proving something or by displaying how it works.
